description: User-controlled memory across conversations: save and recall preferences, knowledge, decisions, and work context.

interface.longDescription: XMemo saves and recalls your preferences, knowledge, decisions, and useful context across conversations and compatible AI agents. One Memory Steward handles general memory and tool selection. Six focused skills cover brainstorming, planning, plan review, progress auditing, session distillation, and work continuity, including resume and handoff. Personal memories need no project; writes follow your saving intent.
defaultPrompt: Remember that I prefer concise answers in Chinese.
What preferences have I saved about how you should answer?
Help me resume the work I saved most recently.

publication.release_notes: XMemo 1.0.2 strengthens Memory Steward and adds six focused workflow skills. Work Continuity combines resume and handoff. Shared rules clarify data boundaries and saving authorization. Reuses the existing authenticated MCP connection without ZIP auth overrides; no new server-side tools.
